snippet.title: Hero's Hour 2 - Announcement Trailer | Fantasy Turn-Based Strategy
snippet.description:
In this strategy RPG auto battler, grand empires clash across procedurally generated maps, and battles rely on powerful combinations of units and spells working in harmony. Take charge of your warriors, arm your heroes with powerful equipment, explore worlds of surprising synergies, and crush your foes as they seek to do the same.

➤Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043740/Heros_Hour_2
